successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: Arochukwu and the Aro country, taken in the Aro Expedition of 1901-1902

ledger.x: 1640: the Aro Confederacy is founded at Arochukwu.
start of the 19th century: Aro commanders extend the Aro country.
1901 (28 November): the British launch the Aro Expedition.
1902 (March): the Aro country passes to the British.

wars.name: Anglo-Aro War
wars.outcome: British victory: Arochukwu captured 28 December 1901, last major battle at Bende in spring 1902, Aro dominance gone in March 1902; the Ibini Ukpabi oracle was a target of the plan (the page says the shrine still exists at Arochukwu).

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the Aro were a trading network of settlements and an oracle, drawn here as a region.
